messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: change window starting for model-serving/inference-router -> v2.4.0. Rollout-id=rlt-2026-07-01-01. Canary: 5% global, per-region step. SLO gating: p95 < 220ms, 5xx < 0.4% over 10m. Notify this channel on SLO violation.
matt-oncall: ACK. I'll shadow eu-west and ap-south. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/serve/inference-router?panelId=5
metrics-bot: Initial snapshot: global p95=190ms, ap-south-1 p95=210ms, eu-west p95=200ms. 5xx global=0.12%.
jessica-platform: heads up: this build enables new gpt-quant codec which increases embed-service CPU on cold paths. watch embed route.
metrics-bot: Alert (ap-south-1): 5xx rate for embed-route rose to 0.72% over last 6m. Query used: ```sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeds-service",region="ap-south-1",code=~"5.."}[6m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeds-service",region="ap-south-1"}[6m])) * 100```
ops-bot: Correlation: deploy step reached ap-south-1 canary at +00:04. No HPA events. Pod restarts: 0.
matt-oncall: That breaches our 0.4% threshold. Ops rule: auto-pause if 5xx >= 0.5% for 5m in a region. @deploy-bot please isolate ap-south-1 and reduce canary there to 0%.
deploy-bot: Received region-isolate request. Actions: routing-rule update -> divert canary traffic in ap-south-1 back to stable v2.3.9. Canary global reduced to 3% (eu-west + us-west). Rollout note: "isolate ap-south-1 due to embeds 5xx spike".
sre-alyssa: digging traces for embed-service in ap-south-1. Trace shows: heavy GC pauses on embed-worker-2 and long DB tail latency. Stack excerpt: ```embed-worker.process -> serialize_batch -> dbclient.query.wait > 1500ms```
jessica-platform: can we throttle concurrency or enable fail-open fallbacks for embed-route while triaging? config: ```routes:
  - path: /v1/embeds
    fallback: cached-embeds
    maxConcurrency: 50```
matt-oncall: For now we left ap-south isolated, no customer alerts. Ops wants an incident card. @ops-bot open incident: "ap-south embed 5xx during canary - isolate region"
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-07-01-AP-EMBED. Link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-07-01-AP-EMBED
sre-alyssa: Recommendation: rollback embed-service to previous replica set (rs-2026-06-29) in ap-south and bump DB pool maxConnections by +20%. If rollback ok, we can reintroduce canary at 1% after 30m watch.
jessica-platform: I'll push helm patch for db.pool.maxConnections=120 and a temporary fallback config. Pushing now: `helm upgrade embeds-service --set db.pool.maxConnections=120 --reuse-values`
metrics-bot: After isolate: ap-south-1 5xx dropped to 0.09% within 2m of routing change. p95 for router remains elevated by +40ms in ap-south due to inflight traces.
matt-oncall: Good. We'll keep canary paused in ap-south. Global rollout continues except that region. Leave thread for triage handoff to platform. Post back when helm rollout and DB bump complete.
jessica-platform: Patch applied and rollout started. Pod template changed; monitor logs for DB errors.
ops-bot: Rollout log updated: https://releases.redwood.local/rollouts/rlt-2026-07-01-01 (ap-south isolated). Snapshot attached.
__notes: synthetic slack thread for release/monitoring coordination during change window; includes deploy-bot actions, automated alerts, region isolate and triage plan
